scope.current_boundary: Teach definition and meaning of root-mean-square speed c_rms = sqrt(<c^2>), deduce average translational kinetic energy E_K = 3/2 kT by comparing pV = 1/3 N m <c^2> with pV = NkT, relate c_rms to temperature and molecular mass (c_rms = sqrt(3kT/m) = sqrt(3RT/M_m)), and deduce total internal energy of an ideal gas U = 3/2 NkT. Do not pre-teach subsequent syllabus topics such as thermal energy transfer, heat capacities, or the first law of thermodynamics with PV work.
